استفهمت (form X)
# اِسْتَفْهَمْتُ (istafhamtu) /is.taf.ham.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# اِسْتَفْهَمْتَ (istafhamta) /is.taf.ham.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# اِسْتَفْهَمْتِ (istafhamti) /is.taf.ham.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# اِسْتَفْهَمَتْ (istafhamat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
